title: Verificare che le due impostazioni password si siano salvate davvero
body: M1 e' chiusa: la riga in system_job_runs e' arrivata la notte del 9 agosto. Resta un conto aperto di integrita', non di prodotto: il dashboard Supabase salva l'intero form in un'unica operazione, e il rifiuto del toggle Pro (leaked password, non disponibile sul piano free) puo' aver annullato anche lunghezza minima e requisiti. Sono registrati come applicati in findings.csv e nella nota di compliance: se non lo sono, quelle due righe dicono il falso, ed e' peggio di non averle scritte.
code:
-- Supabase > Authentication > Sign In / Providers > Email
--   'Minimum password length' deve leggere 8, non 6
--   'Password requirements' deve avere un'opzione selezionata
-- se sono tornati a 6 / vuoto: rimettili col toggle leaked password SPENTO, salva,
-- e poi correggi la riga 'accepted' in findings.csv (le mitigazioni non ci sono)

title: Pull Resend activation forward from December to August
body: The pipeline is built and dark. Until it is on, every improvement to the customer journey is invisible to anyone who closes the tab — which is most people. It is a DNS record, a key and a deliverability test, currently scheduled four months after the flows it serves.

title: Run the tracker from the new files and delete the old habits
body: milestones.csv and roadmap.csv are the only things you edit now. The generator writes roadmap.md and roadmap.html; the GitHub Action does it for you on every push that touches them. The xlsx Gantt is retired — the timeline in roadmap.html replaces it at milestone level.
code:
python3 roadmap/build_roadmap.py     # regenerate md + html
python3 roadmap/sync_status.py       # check the CSV against recent commits
open roadmap/roadmap.html            # the view
